items.title_en: Causal analysis of rock-biodiversity relationships over the global Phanerozoic challenges rock record bias and common cause hypothesis
items.title_zh: 全球显生宙岩石-生物多样性关系的因果分析：对岩石记录偏差与共同原因假说的挑战
items.abstract_en: Sampled marine biodiversity covaries strongly with sedimentary rock quantity over the Phanerozoic, but the respective contributions of different potential causes remain unsettled. Although regional studies show that rock-record bias accounts for more variation in sampled marine biodiversity than common-cause mechanisms, evaluating this relationship across the global Phanerozoic record remains difficult because fossil databases are inherently biased toward fossiliferous strata. To address this limitation, we compiled literature-derived measures of global marine biodiversity and sedimentary strata, along with an existing sea-level curve. Using an information-theoretic causal framework, we then evaluated the relative contributions of rock-record bias and common-cause hypotheses to Phanerozoic-scale variation in sampled marine biodiversity. Our results show a strong contemporaneous causality of marine strata on sampled biodiversity, indicating that rock record bias detected at regional scales extends to the global scale. However, neither rock record bias nor common-cause mechanisms accounts for most Phanerozoic-scale patterns in sampled biodiversity, and additional unmeasured factors likely contribute. Finally, we find tentative evidence that synergistic causality between geologically mediated sampling biases and forces shaping the underlying biological signal contributes to global Phanerozoic patterns in sampled biodiversity.
items.abstract_zh: 在显生宙期间，采样的海洋生物多样性与沉积岩数量高度协变，但各种潜在原因的贡献仍无定论。区域研究表明，岩石记录偏差比共同原因机制能解释更多采样多样性变异，然而由于化石数据库天然偏向含化石地层，在全球显生宙尺度上评估这一关系仍很困难。为此，我们汇编了来自文献的全球海洋生物多样性与沉积地层指标，并结合已有的海平面曲线，采用信息论因果框架，评估岩石记录偏差假说与共同原因假说对显生宙尺度采样生物多样性变异的相对贡献。结果显示，海相地层对采样多样性存在很强的同期因果关系，表明区域尺度检出的岩石记录偏差可延伸至全球尺度；但无论岩石记录偏差还是共同原因机制，都无法解释采样生物多样性的大部分显生宙格局，提示还有未测量的因素在起作用。最后，我们获得初步证据：地质介导的采样偏差与塑造真实生物信号的动力之间的协同因果，可能共同贡献于全球显生宙采样生物多样性格局。
items.highlight_zh: 岩石记录偏差可延伸至全球尺度，但仍不足以解释多数多样性格局
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究了什么问题：海洋化石记录的「生物多样性」与沉积岩数量在显生宙高度同步起伏。这有两种解释：一是「岩石记录偏差」——岩石多的地方化石才多，多样性曲线其实反映的是岩石多少；二是「共同原因」——某个共同因素（如海平面变化）同时影响岩石沉积和真实生物多样性。两者各占多少，一直未有定论。
2. 用了什么方法：作者汇编了文献来源的全球海洋生物多样性与沉积地层数据，并引入已有海平面曲线，采用信息论因果分析框架，量化各因素对采样多样性的因果贡献。这一框架能区分「同期因果」「共同原因」乃至「协同因果」，而不是仅看相关性。
3. 有什么结果：海相地层对采样多样性存在很强的同期因果效应，说明区域研究中发现的岩石记录偏差在全球尺度同样成立。但关键的是，岩石记录偏差与共同原因机制都无法解释采样多样性的大部分显生宙格局，意味着还有尚未测量的因素参与。作者还发现初步证据，支持采样偏差与真实生物信号驱动因素之间存在协同因果。
4. 为何重要：这提醒古生物学家，宏观演化曲线既不是纯粹的「岩石假象」，也不能简单等同于真实多样性历史，解读深时生物多样性趋势时必须更加谨慎，并促使后续研究寻找被遗漏的驱动因素。

items.title_en: Histological morphometric correlates of MRI-defined cortical thinning in temporal lobe epilepsy
items.title_zh: 颞叶癫痫中MRI所定义皮质变薄的组织学形态计量学关联
items.abstract_en: Large-scale MRI studies have consistently demonstrated progressive and age-accelerated neocortical thinning in temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE). These findings are frequently interpreted as evidence of cumulative neurodegeneration. However, the histopathological substrates underlying MRI-confirmed cortical thinning in epilepsy remain poorly defined. In particular, it is unknown whether cortical thinning reflects irreversible neuronal loss or potentially reversible epilepsy-related network alterations in cortical microstructure. We analysed the resected middle temporal gyrus from 117 individuals undergoing surgery for temporal lobe epilepsy, including cases with (n= 74) or without hippocampal sclerosis (HS) and 12 cases with additional temporal lobe sclerosis (TLS, or Focal Cortical Dysplasia IIIa), defined by a distinct pattern of cytoarchitectural reorganisation and gliosis involving superficial layers. All cases were stratified by the presence or absence of pre-operative MRI-defined cortical thinning of the middle temporal gyrus, quantified using CAT12 relative to healthy controls. On NeuN-immuno-labelled sections using automated image analysis we assessed neuronal spatial distributions relative to their size and packing density; relative cortical layer thickness and sulcal-gyral cytoarchitectural variation were also quantified. MRI-defined cortical thinning was not associated with diffuse neuronal loss. Instead, thinning correlated with increased neuronal density and altered cell-size spatial organisation in superficial and deep layers, particularly in right temporal lobe epilepsy cases with HS. There was limited evidence of layer-specific laminar thinning, being confined to layer VI in the right TLE/HS group only. Of note, TLS cases did not show either cortical thinning on MRI or laminar thinning on histology compared to cases without TLS but altered neuronal densities and composition that was not confined to the superficial cortex. MRI cortical thinning was also characterised by attenuation of normal sulcal/gyral cytoarchitectural variations suggesting disruption of cortical architectural gradients. In contrast, cases with HS but without MRI cortical thinning demonstrated loss of the expected inter-hemispheric cytoarchitectural asymmetry, indicating a distinct pathological process dissociated from thinning. Clinical-pathological correlations were lateralised, including age of onset, further supporting distinct mechanisms contributing to MRI cortical thinning between left and right TLE. These findings challenge the prevailing assumption that MRI-defined cortical thinning in epilepsy reflects progressive neuronal degeneration. Rather than laminar neuronal loss and atrophy, thinning was associated with altered neuronal packing and cell-size distributions between layers. This points towards altered neuropil volumes, including myelin content and dendritic remodelling, in turn suggesting potentially reversible dynamic seizure- or network-related processes.
items.abstract_zh: 大规模MRI研究一致显示颞叶癫痫（TLE）存在进行性且与年龄加速相关的新皮质变薄，常被解读为累积性神经退行的证据，但癫痫中MRI确认的皮质变薄的组织病理学基础仍不清楚，尤其不明变薄究竟反映不可逆的神经元丢失，还是可能可逆的癫痫相关皮质微结构网络改变。我们分析了117例因颞叶癫痫接受手术者切除的中颞回，包括伴（n=74）或不伴海马硬化（HS）者，以及12例合并颞叶硬化（TLS，即局灶性皮质发育不良IIIa）者——后者以累及浅层的独特细胞构筑重组与胶质增生为特征。所有病例按术前MRI中颞回是否变薄分层，变薄以CAT12相对健康对照量化。在NeuN免疫标记切片上，我们用自动图像分析评估神经元空间分布与其大小、密度关系，并量化相对皮质层厚度及沟回细胞构筑差异。MRI定义的变薄与弥漫性神经元丢失无关；相反，变薄与神经元密度增高及浅层、深层细胞大小空间组织改变相关，尤其见于右侧TLE伴HS病例。分层变薄的证据有限，仅见于右侧TLE/HS组的第VI层。值得注意的是，TLS病例未出现皮质变薄。
items.highlight_zh: MRI皮质变薄并非神经元丢失，而是密度与空间组织改变
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究了什么问题：很多MRI研究发现颞叶癫痫患者大脑新皮质逐渐变薄，人们常把它当作「神经元在不断死亡」的证据。但影像变薄背后的细胞层面变化其实没人看清：究竟是神经元真的少了，还是皮质微结构/网络发生了可能可逆的改变？
2. 用了什么方法：作者收集了117例颞叶癫痫手术切除的中颞回组织，其中74例伴海马硬化（HS），另有12例合并颞叶硬化（TLS，即局灶性皮质发育不良IIIa型）。先按术前MRI（用CAT12软件与健康人比较）判断中颞回是否变薄来分组，再在NeuN染色切片上用自动图像分析测量神经元的大小、密度和空间排布，以及各皮质层的相对厚度和沟回处的细胞构筑差异。
3. 有什么结果：MRI变薄与弥漫性神经元丢失没有关系。变薄真正对应的是神经元密度升高、浅层与深层中细胞大小空间组织的改变，在右侧颞叶癫痫伴海马硬化的病例中尤为明显。真正的「分层变薄」证据很少，只出现在右侧TLE/HS组的第VI层。而TLS病例根本没有出现影像学变薄。
4. 为何重要：这提示MRI上的皮质变薄未必是神经元死亡，更可能是癫痫相关网络与皮质微结构的重组，从而有可能是可逆的。这会影响医生和研究者对癫痫「神经退行」的解读，也提示不能仅凭影像变薄判断病情不可逆。

items.title_en: DELLA proteins modulate responsive and buffered transcriptional programs in Arabidopsis and rice roots under water limitation
items.title_zh: DELLA蛋白在水分限制下调控拟南芥与水稻根系的响应型与缓冲型转录程序
items.abstract_en: Water limitation constrains plant growth and productivity, yet the molecular mechanisms regulating root responses remain incompletely understood. The DELLA repressors of gibberellin signaling are key growth regulators under stress, but their role in shaping transcriptional responses to water limitation, and its conservation, remain unclear. Here, we investigated DELLA function in roots of Arabidopsis thaliana and Oryza sativa under reduced water availability simulated by polyethylene glycol (PEG). Loss of DELLA function reduced the sensitivity of root growth to water limitation, affecting primary root elongation in A. thaliana and crown root formation in O. sativa. Transcriptomic profiling revealed extensive DELLA-dependent regulation, partitioned into two modes: (i) genes requiring DELLAs for appropriate responses to water limitation ('WT-responsive'), and (ii) genes whose responsiveness is detected predominantly in the absence of DELLAs ('buffered', an operational label for an expression pattern, not a demonstrated mechanism). These patterns suggest that DELLAs both enable specific responses and apparently constrain broader transcriptional responsiveness under osmotic stress. Although the requirement for DELLA function is conserved, the developmental outputs and downstream transcriptional programs are largely species-specific. Together, our results identify DELLAs as key modulators of root responses to water limitation, with a proposed dual role in shaping and limiting transcriptional dynamics.
items.abstract_zh: 水分限制制约植物生长与生产力，但调控根系响应的分子机制仍不完全清楚。赤霉素信号的DELLA抑制因子是胁迫下的关键生长调控者，但其在塑造水分限制转录响应中的作用及其保守性仍不明确。我们在聚乙二醇（PEG）模拟的供水减少条件下，研究拟南芥与水稻根系中DELLA的功能。DELLA功能缺失降低了根生长对水分限制的敏感性，影响拟南芥主根伸长和水稻冠根形成。转录组分析揭示了广泛的DELLA依赖性调控，并可分为两种模式：（i）需要DELLA才能对水分限制做出适当响应的基因（“WT响应型”）；（ii）主要在缺乏DELLA时才检测到响应性的基因（“缓冲型”，仅为表达模式的操作性标签，并非已证实的机制）。这些模式提示，DELLA既促成了特定响应，又似乎约束了渗透胁迫下更广泛的转录响应性。尽管对DELLA功能的需求是保守的，发育输出与下游转录程序却 largely 具有物种特异性。综上，本研究将DELLA鉴定为根系响应水分限制的关键调节因子，并提出其在塑造与限制转录动态方面的双重作用。
items.highlight_zh: DELLA既开启特定抗旱响应，又缓冲整体转录可塑性
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究了什么问题：缺水会限制植物生长，根系是最先感知并作出反应的器官，但其中分子开关仍不清楚。DELLA蛋白是赤霉素信号的抑制因子，已知是胁迫下控制生长的重要调控者，但它在「缺水时基因表达如何改变」中扮演什么角色、这种角色在拟南芥和水稻之间是否保守，此前并不明确。
2. 用了什么方法：作者用聚乙二醇（PEG）模拟水分减少，比较正常植株与DELLA功能缺失突变体的根系：一方面测量根的生长表型（拟南芥看主根伸长，水稻看冠根形成），另一方面做转录组测序，找出哪些基因的缺水响应依赖DELLA。
3. 有什么结果：缺失DELLA后，根生长对缺水变得不那么敏感，说明DELLA是让根「因缺水而减速」的必要环节。转录组上出现两类DELLA依赖模式：一类基因必须有DELLA才能正常响应缺水（WT响应型）；另一类基因的响应反而主要在缺DELLA时才显现（缓冲型，作者强调这只是描述表达模式的操作性标签，机制未证实）。这说明DELLA一方面「开启」特定响应，另一方面又「压住」更广泛的转录波动。此外，虽然对DELLA的需求在两个物种中都保守，但具体的发育结果和下游基因程序大多物种特异。
4. 为何重要：该研究把DELLA定位为根系应对缺水的核心调节枢纽，并提出「塑造+限制」的双重角色，为理解作物抗旱性的保守性与差异性、以及改良根系耐旱性提供了线索。

items.title_en: Anti-GABAB receptor autoimmunity causes cognitive decline by presynaptic pathology
items.title_zh: 抗GABAB受体自身免疫通过突触前病理导致认知功能下降
items.abstract_en: The GABAB receptor is a central regulator of neuronal transmission and excitability by pre- and postsynaptic mechanisms. Its dysfunction causes severe neurological disease, but the underlying pathomechanisms remain elusive. Here, we exploit a distinct CNS autoimmune disorder in which patients develop specific autoantibodies against GABAB receptors causing autoimmune encephalitis with severe memory dysfunction and epilepsy. We demonstrate that human autoantibodies target the sushi-domains of the GABAB receptor B1a subunit and the B2 subunit and interfere with presynaptic signaling. This specific presynaptic pathology results from exclusive functional antagonism of the B1a subunit and disrupts short- and long-term synaptic plasticity, abnormally amplifies hippocampal network oscillations and coupling in vivo, and ultimately impairs memory consolidation. Our results demonstrate that autoimmune presynaptic pathomechanisms alone are sufficient to interfere with memory processing, thus defining a causal link between molecular GABAB receptor disturbance, synaptic pathology, circuit dysfunction, and dementia distinct from classical neurodegenerative processes.

items.title_en: Nanoarchitecture of the presynaptic cell adhesion molecule PTPσ in relation to prospective vesicle fusion sites and postsynaptic NMDA receptors
items.title_zh: 突触前细胞黏附分子PTPσ的纳米结构及其与潜在囊泡融合位点和突触后NMDA受体的关系
items.abstract_en: Protein organization at individual synapses tunes synaptic function. Presynaptic release-regulating proteins and postsynaptic receptors each concentrate into subsynaptic nanoclusters, and their precise alignment across the cleft into nanocolumns can maximize receptor activation following vesicle fusion. However, both the molecular organization defining presynaptic fusion sites and the mechanisms by which they are spatially coordinated with postsynaptic complexes remains unclear. Presynaptic transmembrane cell adhesion molecules may mediate both processes as they could simultaneously anchor cytosolic fusion machinery to the presynaptic membrane and bridge the cleft to coordinate PSD organization. The LAR-RPTP family member PTP{sigma} is an important possibility, as its trans-synaptic interactors that bind PSD-95 are associated with NMDAR dysfunction, suggesting PTP{sigma} may coordinate NMDAR positioning. However, PTP{sigma}'s subsynaptic organization has not been determined. Here, we investigate the cellular expression and subsynaptic nano-organization of endogenous PTP{sigma} in cultured rat hippocampal neurons. We find that PTP{sigma} is enriched at most excitatory synapses, but unexpectedly, PTP{sigma} nanoclusters do not colocalize with the vesicle priming protein Munc13-1. Instead, they adopt a stereotyped position adjacent to this machinery, without preferential association with sites in nanocolumns. PTP{sigma} nanoclusters also lie offset from postsynaptic NMDA receptors, mirroring their relationship to vesicle fusion sites, yet the presence of PTP{sigma} at a nanocolumn does not predict NMDAR abundance. Together, these findings suggest that PTP{sigma} does not directly coordinate release site - NMDAR alignment but instead occupies defined nanoscale positions adjacent to vesicle fusion sites, potentially helping to shape or stabilize the vesicle priming landscape of the active zone.

items.title_en: Cellular and mitochondrial correlates of regional glucose metabolism in the human cortex
items.title_zh: 人脑皮层区域葡萄糖代谢的细胞与线粒体相关性
items.abstract_en: Regional differences in human brain glucose metabolism reflect local energy demands, but their cellular and mitochondrial determinants remain unclear. We combined [18F]FDG positron emission tomography in healthy human participants with estimates of cellular composition and mitochondrial density to unravel (sub)cellular correlates of heterogeneity in brain glucose metabolism. By correcting for RNA content and differential gene expression due to postmortem sampling, we addressed methodological shortcomings in multimodal neuroimaging integration. We introduce transcriptionally derived cytoarchitectonic maps of the human cortex that are consistent with histological findings, providing a biologically grounded framework for relating in vivo neuroimaging signals. Accordingly, mitochondrial distribution showed strong association with the intrinsic energy requirements at resting state. In contrast, relations between metabolism and neuronal composition were driven by sensory input and mitochondria-sparse thin-axon neurons, suggesting that stimulation-induced energy demand is met rather by neuronal processes that are independent of mitochondrial abundance to maintain efficient information processing.

items.title_en: Building Bridges Belowground: Pythium oligandrum En-hances Rhizosphere Network Connectivity
items.title_zh: 在地下搭建桥梁：寡雄腐霉增强根际网络连通性
items.abstract_en: Biological control agents (BCAs) offer a potential sustainable alternative to fungicides for crop dis-ease management, but their effects on resident plant microbiomes and microbial interactions remain poorly understood. Here, we investigated the effects of the BCA Pythium oligandrum on disease con-trol and the rhizosphere microbiome of starch potato cv. Kuras in a field trial. We compared a labora-tory strain and a commercial formulation (Polygandron) with commonly used fungicides during early blight development. The laboratory strain suppressed early blight at plant senescence, but this effect did not persist until harvest, whereas fungicide treatment provided near-complete disease suppression throughout the growing season. P. oligandrum caused transient changes in rhizosphere fungal com-munity composition at flowering, while bacterial community richness varied among sampling times in untreated controls. However, bacterial co-occurrence network analysis revealed pronounced treat-ment-specific changes in microbial connectivity. Application of the laboratory strain increased net-work connectivity, resulting in almost a threefold increase in mean degree and greater interconnected-ness among bacterial taxa. In contrast, Polygandron and fungicide treatments reduced mean degree, indicating reduced connectivity within the bacterial network. Fungicide treatment additionally altered network organisation, including increased betweenness centrality and changes in modularity. Togeth-er, our results show that P. oligandrum can modify microbial interactions in the potato rhizosphere without substantially altering overall bacterial community composition, highlighting the value of in-tegrating microbial network structure with community-level analyses when evaluating the ecological effects of BCAs.

items.title_en: A finished, telomere-to-telomere assembly for Botrytis cinerea strain B05.10
items.title_zh: 灰葡萄孢菌株B05.10的完整端粒到端粒组装
items.abstract_en: We present an improved genome assembly of Botrytis cinerea strain B05.10 which serves as a reference isolate for most labs active in the Botrytis research. The existing assembly dating from 2017 was extended by adding 8 telomeric regions and a small number of minor errors was corrected. The new assembly contains telomeres on each chromosome end, except for Chr4 carrying the rDNA repeat. The unannotated assembly is deposited in NCBI and manual curation of gene models is ongoing. The new assembly will be hosted on Ensembl-Fungi after completion of the structural curation.

items.title_en: Telomere Maintenance Is Acquired at Liposarcoma Dedifferentiation, and Genetically Longer Telomeres Are Associated With Liposarcoma Risk
items.title_zh: 脂肪肉瘤去分化时获得端粒维持，遗传上较长的端粒与脂肪肉瘤风险相关
items.abstract_en: PURPOSE The impact of telomere length, telomerase gene alterations and alternative lengthening of the telomere in sarcoma subtypes remains unclear. METHODS We have analyzed 11,792 patients with sarcoma next-generation sequencing performed across 19 centers in AACR Project GENIE v20.0. Telomerase activation was defined as TERT promoter mutation, amplification, or rearrangement, and ATRX/DAXX inactivation served as the ALT proxy. Findings were tested for TERT expression in The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), for overall survival (OS) in MSK-IMPACT 50K, and for replication in an independent Foundation Medicine cohort. Mendelian randomization (MR) in FinnGen tested germline telomere length. RESULTS Telomerase activation (8.8%) and ATRX/DAXX loss (8.0%) were mutually exclusive across subtypes (odds ratio [OR], 0.52; 95% CI, 0.29 to 0.92) and segregated by histology. In MDM2-amplified dedifferentiated liposarcoma (DDLPS), telomerase was activated through TERT amplification (17.2%) or rearrangement (2.7%), never promoter mutation (0/261), and never with ATRX/DAXX loss (0/49; P = .011). TERT-amplified tumors expressed TERT (TCGA; P = .002), and amplification was largely focal. Telomere maintenance alterations were present in 28.0% of DDLPS versus 8.7% of well-differentiated liposarcoma (P < .001) and predicted shorter OS in DDLPS (hazard ratio, 2.04; 95% CI, 1.23 to 3.39; P = .005). ATRX/DAXX loss was more frequent in uterine than extrauterine leiomyosarcoma in GENIE (adjusted OR, 1.96) and in the independent cohort (OR, 1.95; both P < .001). Genetically longer telomeres were associated with liposarcoma (OR per SD, 4.10; 95% CI, 2.15 to 7.81). CONCLUSION Sarcoma telomere maintenance is histology-specific, telomerase activation and ALT are mutually exclusive. In liposarcoma it is acquired at dedifferentiation through focal TERT amplification or ALT and identifies DDLPS with inferior survival. Long telomere was associated with elevated risk of liposarcoma genetically.

items.title_en: Real-world cardiovascular effects of liraglutide: transportability analysis of the LEADER trial
items.title_zh: 利拉鲁肽的真实世界心血管效应：LEADER试验的可迁移性分析
items.abstract_en: Appropriate use of recently approved type 2 diabetes treatments depends on the external validity of landmark randomized clinical trials (RCTs) in real-world populations that may differ from trial participants. This study transported effect estimates from the Liraglutide Effect and Action in Diabetes: Evaluation of Cardiovascular Outcome Results (LEADER) trial, a placebo-controlled RCT of liraglutide on cardiovascular outcomes, onto real-world cohorts within the Veterans Affairs (VA) healthcare system. Risk differences (RDs) in survival outcomes, approximated using pseudo-observations of individual survival probabilities, were estimated with augmented inverse probability weighting after balancing baseline characteristics between RCT and target samples using approximate balancing weights. Transported effects of liraglutide compared with placebo on major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) and all-cause mortality in veterans (VA-weighted LEADER) were larger than, though statistically consistent with, the treatment effects observed in LEADER: MACE RD at 3 years of 4.6% (95% CI, 2.2, 7.0) in VA-weighted LEADER vs 1.6% (0.3, 2.9) in LEADER; all-cause mortality RD at 3 years of 2.9% (0.8, 5.1) in VA-weighted LEADER vs 0.9% (-0.1, 1.9) in LEADER. These estimates of the effects of liraglutide in veterans with diabetes provide real-world evidence that can guide diabetes treatment decisions and formulary policies for a high-risk population underrepresented in RCTs.

items.title_en: Subjective social status is associated with depressive symptoms beyond objective socioeconomic status among Chinese residents: a cross-sectional study
items.title_zh: 中国居民主观社会地位与抑郁症状的关联超出客观社会经济地位：一项横断面研究
items.abstract_en: Background: Socioeconomic status is strongly associated with depressive symptoms, but whether this reflects material conditions or perceived position is unclear. We tested whether subjective social status relates to symptoms independently of objective SES. Methods: Using the 2022 Psychology and Behavior Investigation of Chinese Residents (PBICR2022), we analyzed 19,048 community residents. Objective SES was built by principal component analysis from income, education, employment, and housing. Subjective status was measured with a 7-point item and depressive symptoms with the Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9). Analyses used hierarchical regression, bootstrap mediation, moderated mediation, and response surface analysis. Results: Probable depression prevalence was 21.77%. Subjective status was inversely associated with symptoms ({beta} = -0.098). Objective SES showed no overall association (total effect = -0.009, p = .30), with a weak protective association only among adults ([≥] 18 years; -0.025, p = .004). Its protective value operated through subjective status: higher objective status went with higher identification, and higher identification with fewer symptoms (indirect effect = -0.020, 95% CI [-0.024, -0.016]). This channel was stronger in never-married than married adults (difference = -0.015, 95% CI [-0.026, -0.003]), though non-significant in stratified tests, thus suggestive. Never-married adults may lack this social validation and rely more on self-rated standing. No sex or migration differences appeared. Subjective status outweighed objective conditions, protection leveling off at high status. Conclusions: Subjective status was more closely linked to symptoms than objective conditions, whose value operated mainly through raised subjective status. Cross-sectional design precludes causal inference.

items.title_en: Predicting HPV/p16 Status and Molecular Subtypes from Histopathology Slides using Deep Learning in Vulvar Squamous Cell Carcinoma
items.title_zh: 利用深度学习从组织病理学切片预测外阴鳞状细胞癌的HPV/p16状态和分子亚型
items.abstract_en: Vulvar squamous cell carcinoma (VSCC) comprises three prognostically distinct molecular subtypes: human papillomavirus (HPV)-associated, HPV-independent/p53-wildtype, and HPV-independent/p53-abnormal. Classification requires p16/p53 immunohistochemistry, which consumes tissue and is often incomplete in retrospective cohorts. We investigated whether deep learning could predict HPV/p16 status and molecular subtypes directly from routine hematoxylin and eosin-stained whole-slide images. Using features extracted with H-optimus-1, we developed two attention-based multiple-instance learning models: HERA, predicting HPV/p16 status, and HERMES, predicting the three molecular subtypes. Models were developed on 644 patients from three Dutch VSCC cohorts and tested on 286 patients from two independent cohorts. In independent testing, HERA achieved an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.84 (95% CI 0.75-0.91), with specificity 0.93, negative predictive value 0.94, and sensitivity 0.68. HERA-predicted groups reproduced the prognostic separation of HPV testing (log-rank p<0.001). HERMES achieved a macro-average AUC of 0.70 (0.66-0.75), with good discrimination for HPV-associated (0.80) but limited separation of HPV-independent/p53-abnormal (AUC 0.68) and HPV-independent/p53-wildtype (AUC 0.63). HERMES-predicted classes reproduced the prognostic hierarchy, with 5-year recurrence rates of 14.0% (HPV-associated), 31.1% (HPV-independent/p53-wildtype) and 43.3% (HPV-independent/p53-abnormal) (p=0.0051). Highly attended tiles showed basaloid cells and koilocytotic-like atypia in HPV-associated tumors, keratinizing nests with desmoplastic stroma in HPV-independent/p53-abnormal tumors, and well-differentiated keratinocytes with spongiosis in HPV-independent/p53-wildtype tumors. HERA could assign HPV/p16 status to large retrospective VSCC cohorts lacking ancillary testing, without consuming tissue, enabling HPV-stratified outcome analyses. Before such use, external validation of its discrimination and calibration across scanners and populations is required. HERMES suggests that molecular subtype information is encoded in hematoxylin and eosin-stained slides, but requires improved distinction between the HPV-independent subtypes.

items.title_en: Sex Differences Across the Donor Heart Offer-to-Outcome Pathway: A Linked National Cohort Study
items.title_zh: 供体心脏从分配提议到结局路径中的性别差异：一项关联全国队列研究
items.abstract_en: Background: Sex differences occur across heart transplantation, but where they become apparent between donor-heart offers and post-transplant outcomes is uncertain. Methods: We linked UNOS STAR Q2 2025 candidate, donor, transplant, and PTR match-run data across pre- and post-2018 eras. Analyses included 51,970 listing episodes, 1,388,553 actual offers, and 38,417 recipients and evaluated access, conditional final acceptance, donor profiles, severe predicted heart mass (PHM) undersizing (ratio <0.86), treated rejection, and 365-day survival. Results: Transplant access increased in both sexes without evidence of sex-by-era modification (P=.133). Offers made to female candidates had higher adjusted conditional final-acceptance probabilities in both eras (interaction P=.172). After recipient-size standardization, severe PHM undersizing among realized offers remained less frequent for women than men pre-policy (28.9% vs 38.3%) and post-policy (25.5% vs 35.4%); acceptance of undersized offers was not lower for female candidates (three-way interaction P=.800). The threshold donor composite showed modest differences that reversed direction across eras. Adjusted treated rejection remained higher among women (male vs female OR, 0.667; 95% CI, 0.589-0.756), including after post-policy cPRA adjustment (OR, 0.678; 95% CI, 0.583-0.790). Adjusted post-policy 365-day survival was 91.0% in women and 92.3% in men; the sex difference did not change across eras (-0.64 percentage points; 95% CI, -1.97 to 0.68; P=.341). Conclusions: Sex-associated patterns were stage-specific and multidirectional. The final-graft PHM difference was already evident among realized offers after size standardization and was not explained solely by lower acceptance of undersized offers for female candidates. Women nonetheless had more treated rejection, while short-term survival differences did not change significantly across eras. Transplantation performance should be assessed separately across offer exposure, acceptance, matching, and outcomes.

items.title_en: Caesarean section in Bangladesh, 2012-13 to 2025: facility birth, the private sector and small-area geography
items.title_zh: 孟加拉国剖宫产（2012-13至2025年）：机构分娩、私营部门与小区域地理
items.abstract_en: Background: In Bangladesh, caesarean section rose from one in five births in 2012-13 to one in two in 2025. We asked how much of this rise came from more facility births, a move to private facilities, and changing rates within sectors. Methods: This repeated cross-sectional study used Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys from 2012-13, 2019 and 2025 (26,539 recent mothers). A Kitagawa decomposition split the rise into parts. For 2025, we mapped caesarean use among facility births in 2,720 clusters and examined modelled travel time. Results: The caesarean rate rose from 19.5% (95% CI 18.1 to 20.9) to 52.0% (50.7 to 53.2). More facility births made up 82.8% (78.9 to 87.7) of this 32.5 point rise and the move to private facilities 12.6% (10.1 to 15.0). In a one-step version, place of birth made up 94.7% (90.7 to 98.9). The private caesarean rate rose from 79.1% to 86.1%, while the public rate fell from 38.7% to 33.5%. Among private first births, which rarely follow a previous caesarean, the 2025 rate was 4.8 points (0.3 to 10.2) above the 2012-13 model's prediction. The 2025 private rate was 85% to 87% in every wealth group. Longer travel time was linked with fewer caesareans, mainly through fewer facility births. Among private-sector births, travel time was not linked with caesarean (prevalence ratio 0.99 per 10 minutes, 0.97 to 1.01). Caesarean use among facility births clustered geographically; the private share of births in nearby clusters, not household factors, accounted for much of this. Conclusions: In accounting terms, most of the rise came from births moving into facilities, mostly private ones, where caesarean was already common. The data cannot show how many caesareans were needed. If 2025 sector mix and rates persist, more facility births would keep raising the national rate.

items.title_en: Community-Level Wastewater Surveillance of Nicotine Biomarkers Tracks Cardiovascular Disease Burden and Myocardial Infarction
items.title_zh: 社区层面尼古丁生物标志物污水监测可追踪心血管疾病负担与心肌梗死
items.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Tobacco smoking is the largest modifiable contributor to cardiovascular disease (CVD), yet population-level surveillance still relies on self-reported and retail data, which are subject to measuring bias and lag. Urinary and salivary cotinine quantify individual tobacco exposure, but no analogous, objective metric exists at the community level. Wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE) has transformed surveillance of infectious diseases and illicit drug use; whether the same approach can yield a community-level signal of CVD risk is unknown. OBJECTIVE: The primary objective of this study is to track community-level wastewater nicotine biomarkers and evaluate potential correlations with relative CVD burden in El Paso, Texas. METHODS: We integrated wastewater nicotine biomarker surveillance with electronic health record (EHR) data across four sewersheds in El Paso, Texas. Twenty-four-hour composite influent samples were collected monthly (June 2024 to May 2025; n=48) and quantified by liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry for five nicotine metabolites. Cotinine, nornicotine, and trans-3-hydroxycotinine (3HC) were detected in 91.6 to 100% of samples, whereas tobacco-specific nitrosamines were below limit of detection. CVD cases (January 2021 to December 2024) were obtained from the Paso del Norte Health Information Exchange and mapped to sewersheds by residential ZIP code using ArcGIS. At the sewershed level, population normalized nicotine mass loads tracked the proportional burden of atherosclerosis/ischemia/infarction and heart failure. Across the sewersheds, monthly 3HC mass load and the nicotine metabolite ratio (NMR) were strongly and specifically associated with incident ST-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) (3HC vs. STEMI: rho=0.893,p=0.012), without parallel associations for non-ST elevation or old myocardial infarction. CONCLUSIONS: To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration that integrating wastewater nicotine surveillance with EHR data can reveal community-level 3HC and NMR as specific indicators of incident STEMI. Our findings indicate wastewater surveillance as a novel, objective tool to inform cessation policy and CVD prevention

items.title_en: USFDA Oncology Drug Approvals from 2014- 2025: Comparing non-immunotherapy and immunotherapy approvals, their endpoints, and their efficacy.
items.title_zh: USFDA 2014—2025年肿瘤药物批准：非免疫治疗与免疫治疗批准、其终点及疗效比较
items.abstract_en: In the United States the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), and in Europe, the European Medicines Agency (EMA) are responsible for regulatory approvals of anti-cancer therapeutics. We examined regulatory approvals by both agencies in the period between 2014 and 2025 and compared immunotherapy and non-immunotherapy approvals for the treatment of cancer. We asked whether the approvals were similar in terms of trial size, endpoints, and development time. We present the data based on the FDA approvals given that the US agency has approved some therapies either rejected by or yet to be approved by the EMA. Beginning with the approval of pembrolizumab for melanoma in 2014 through early 2025 we identified 143 immunotherapy and 211 non-immunotherapy approvals. In the first few years the time to approvals of immunotherapies was markedly less but over time the duration has approached that of non-immunotherapies - with durations of 2079 and 2357 days in 2024/2025 due largely to a median trial size of 461 and 698 participants. Surrogate endpoints have overwhelmed overall survival as the primary endpoint for approval, and we find that with non-immunotherapies only a median of 60% of the benefit predicted from progression/disease/recurrence/event-free survivals translates to overall survival, significantly less than the 99% of the surrogate benefit translated to overall survival for immunotherapies. While the FDA and EMA approval portfolios are very similar, the EMA is on the whole more skeptical/conservative in its approvals. The last decade has seen substantial advances, but much remains to be accomplished against a formidable foe. The size and duration of trials need to be addressed and meaningfully reduced and the validity of surrogates defended.

items.title_en: Trajectories and characteristics of pain in the first year after spinal cord injury: a TRACK-SCI study
items.title_zh: 脊髓损伤后第一年疼痛的轨迹与特征：一项TRACK-SCI研究
items.abstract_en: Chronic pain affects most individuals with spinal cord injury (SCI) and frequently impairs daily function, and nearly half experience neuropathic pain. Neuropathic pain is commonly thought to develop months after injury and to persist once established. These views rest on classifying each patient as having neuropathic pain or not, although patients often report several pains. The same binary label is the usual target of prognostic and biomarker studies that aim to predict life-limiting pain. We tracked up to three of the worst pains per interview from injury to one year in 140 TRACK-SCI participants, using the DN4 interview (DN4i, threshold 3). Within three days of injury, half of all pain areas and three quarters of participants met the threshold, and pain-area prevalence changed little over the year. Individual pains, however, often changed. Only a third remained above the threshold throughout, one third resolved or fluctuated, and pains in the same person often followed different courses. At more than half of interviews with several pains, one pain met the threshold while another did not, so that the patient's classification depended on the pain considered. We therefore derived a threshold-free Pain Composite Score from the DN4i items and pain intensity. The items formed a single dimension, and the composite was associated with sleep and mood interference whereas the binary classification was not. Neuropathic pain after SCI thus appears early, does not invariably persist, and differs between a person's pains, and graded pain-level measures may offer a more stable target for predicting life-limiting pain.

items.title_en: Relevance-Based Prediction: A Transparent, Patient-Specific Approach to Predicting Medical Outcomes
items.title_zh: 基于相关性的预测：一种透明、面向个体患者的医学结局预测方法
items.abstract_en: Accurate prediction of individual medical outcomes is essential for optimizing treatment allocation amid rising costs, coverage denials, and limited clinical resources. Traditional predictive models, including linear regression and neural networks, rely on average effects and cannot tailor predictions to the specific circumstances of individual cases. We present relevance-based prediction (RBP), a model-free and task-specific method that predicts outcomes as weighted averages of observed cases, with weights determined by a rigorously defined and theoretically justified measure of relevance. Unlike model-based methods that rely on fixed calibrated parameters, relevance-based prediction revisits the original data for each prediction and customizes both the cases and variables used. We illustrate RBP by applying it to predict opioid treatment outcomes and demonstrate that it provides case-specific insights unavailable from conventional models, including how each prior case informs a prediction, how each variable affects each predictions reliability and value, and how reliable each prediction is before it is made. These individualized insights may prevent misleading average-based decisions and reduce harmful or suboptimal treatment.
items.abstract_zh: 在成本上升、保险拒付增多和临床资源有限的背景下，准确预测个体医学结局对优化治疗分配至关重要。传统预测模型（包括线性回归与神经网络）依赖平均效应，无法针对个案的具体情形量身定制预测。我们提出基于相关性的预测（RBP）：一种无模型、任务特异的方法，它将结局预测为已观测病例的加权平均，权重由严格定义且有理论依据的相关性度量确定。与依赖固定校准参数的模型化方法不同，RBP在每次预测时都重新检视原始数据，并自定义所使用的病例与变量。我们以阿片类药物治疗结局预测为例展示RBP，证明它能提供传统模型无法给出的个案洞察，包括每个既往病例如何影响某次预测、每个变量如何影响每次预测的可靠性与价值，以及预测在做出之前有多可靠。这些个体化洞察有助于避免误导性的、基于平均值的决策，减少有害或次优的治疗。
items.highlight_zh: 用病例加权的无模型预测，让每个预测都可解释、可追溯
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究了什么问题：医疗资源紧张、费用上涨，如何为每位患者准确预测治疗结局、合理分配治疗，变得非常关键。但常用的线性回归、神经网络等模型依赖「平均效应」，给出的是人群层面的规律，很难贴合某个具体病人的特殊情况，也难解释「为什么这么预测」。
2. 用了什么方法：作者提出「基于相关性的预测」（RBP）。它是一种无模型、针对具体任务的方法：预测值不是由一组固定参数算出，而是取已观测病例的加权平均，权重来自一个被严格定义并有理论依据的「相关性」度量。每次做新预测时，方法都会重新回到原始数据，自己挑选最相关的病例和变量。
3. 有什么结果：作者以阿片类药物治疗结局预测为示例，显示RBP能给出传统模型没有的个案级洞察：某个既往病例如何影响这次预测；每个变量如何影响该次预测的可靠性与价值；以及在预测做出之前，这次预测本身有多可靠。
4. 为何重要：临床决策若只依据群体平均值，可能对个体产生误导。RBP的透明性和个案适配性，有望帮助医生避免「平均化」的错误决策，减少有害或不理想的治疗选择，同时让预测过程可追溯、可解释。

items.title_en: Source-water salinity measured by electrical conductivity in Bangladesh, 2025: a nationally representative cross-sectional survey
items.title_zh: 2025年孟加拉国通过电导率测量的水源盐度：一项全国代表性横断面调查
items.abstract_en: BackgroundIn coastal Bangladesh, saline drinking water has been linked to raised blood pressure. The 2025 Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) measured electrical conductivity (EC), a salinity indicator, in source water, but its report gave no population counts or district estimates. ObjectivesTo estimate how many people live in households whose tested source has high EC, and to describe patterns by place, household characteristics, source type and arsenic. MethodsEC was measured in source water of 6,040 households in 64 districts, February to June. In 14.5% of households the tested source was not the main drinking-water source. Primary outcomes were EC above 1,500 and 3,000 {micro}S/cm, survey risk classes that are not health-based standards. Estimates were survey weighted; comparisons were observational. ResultsEC exceeded 1,500 {micro}S/cm in 5.3% of households (95% CI 4.7 to 5.9), about 9.0 million people, including 1.8 million above 3,000 {micro}S/cm. Coastal-zone districts held 26% of households but 70% of those above 1,500 {micro}S/cm. Shares varied little by wealth or in households with young children or pregnant women. Nationally, deep tube wells more often had high EC because most are coastal. In the coastal zone, deep and shallow wells had similar shares (16.1% and 17.9%). After district adjustment, EC was about 18% lower in deep wells (geometric mean ratio 0.82, 0.73 to 0.92). Within upazilas (restricted sample) it was 0.93 (0.80 to 1.07). Arsenic above 10 ppb was more common where EC was high, but this link weakened after district adjustment. ConclusionsMillions of people live in households whose tested source has high EC, mostly in coastal and south-central districts. Deep wells had modestly lower EC after geographic adjustment, but the difference shrank within upazilas and depended on the handling of implausibly low readings. The findings support measuring EC alongside arsenic, with documented meter calibration.

items.title_en: Patient-keyed aggregation of public cancer genomic data imports clonal hematopoiesis into solid-tumor mutation matrices
items.abstract_en: Large-scale reuse of public cancer genomic data begins by pooling studies into one patient-by-gene matrix, keyed on the patient. Records held under one patient identifier need not come from the same kind of specimen: three clonal-hematopoiesis studies in cBioPortal deposit blood normals sharing patient identifiers with tumors deposited elsewhere, so a patient-keyed merge records a hematopoietic clone as a tumor mutation. We linked 1,282,483 coding calls in 140 genes from 483 studies to patients, classified each by specimen type, and rebuilt the matrix with and without blood-derived calls. Blood normals supply 1.7% of calls but concentrate: 52.8% of patients flagged DNMT3A-mutant, 21.3% of TET2 and 19.7% of CHEK2 have no tumor-derived call in that gene, against 0.4% for TP53. Those calls carry a hematopoietic gene spectrum and, in TP53, hematopoietic allele fractions. The artifact reaches 65 further cohorts, almost all solid-tumor studies, exceeding one patient in ten in fifteen of them, and tracks the share of patients with a paired blood normal, not the disease (r = 0.994, 45 cancer types). Correction lowers the pan-cancer DNMT3A rate by 45% and moves survival estimates further than chance removal of the same patients would. Two filter lines applied before aggregation remove it.
